$comment: The official plugins (the ones DeckPilot bundles) built here, and the permission policy each must keep (official/README.md). `plugins` are released (signed, one GitHub Release per version); `fixtures` are built, packaged, signed with throwaway keys and compared with DeckPilot's build in CI only, never released. `permissions` is the exact set of permission kinds a plugin's manifest may declare: anything else, and every plugin API 1.9 privileged kind while the gate is closed, fails tools/check-official.py.
